design.estimand: percentage-point difference in exact action-count recovery, tagged phrase minus otherwise identical bare plural
design.item_set: 16 fresh plural-predicate reports: eight each-alone truths and eight as-one truths; no source item reused
design.seed_selection: first seed from 2026082100 giving exact 4/4 arm balance within each polarity and at least two calibration cells per arm; selected before reader outcomes
design.reader_scope: one local Gemma3 12B Q4_K_M event-task reader; fresh items and a model not used in the replicated original
design.limitations: tests ambiguity resolution versus bare plural; it does not establish non-inferiority to a full careful-English gloss
